rows.what: Hand-placed RM_WeepingStones biome: sand ground, rich banks, dry/fog/sandstorm weather, disease and forage data, explicit densities, own icon and self-contained scoring worker. No natural placement or alternative planet.
rows.called_by: BiomeDef RM_WeepingStones consumed by local-map terrain, plant/animal spawning, weather and fishing systems; GetScore is inert with generatesNaturally=false
rows.why: The sand/stone and oasis ground is the ordinary place to inhabit.
rows.ticket: none: no separate build or switch-off required

rows.what: Native land/sky race/kind roster, ordinary gorrask and Colossia, with diets, combat, reproduction and taming data. Mirrik def exists but is absent from the current inline wildAnimals block; current runtime spawn route is unproven.
rows.called_by: RM_WeepingStones.wildAnimals + vanilla WildAnimalSpawner/animal needs; mirrored campaign cast added by WildAnimals_WeepingStones.xml
rows.why: Prey, grazers, predators, tame companions and pack beasts are ordinary life; no roster eviction.

rows.what: Mirrik and dewglider carry real flight stats/race flags; current skarrin definition has no flight fields. Legacy net proof still calls skarrin a flier.
rows.called_by: RM_Mirrik and RM_Kirruk race/stat definitions consumed by vanilla Pawn_FlightTracker
rows.why: Deleting real flight makes the dewglider and mirrik ground walkers despite their fiction, violating the standing flyer ruling.

rows.what: Pool race/kind/meat/catch pairs: gentle murrin; skarrin; karrek labelled iaala; vizhik labelled fan eel; loomu, huldu and ivvol; vhorrin is pen-emergent only. Seven species can be netted/stocked; vhorrin is excluded. Vanilla gestation/litter data exists on ordinary stock, but no demonstrated sustainable penned breeding cycle.
rows.called_by: Biome wildAnimals/fishTypes; RM_PoolBreederUtility mappings; NET/STOCK/HARVEST/CULL work givers
rows.why: The living breeder species and their catch/meat forms supply the farming chain; no species is removed. Stock is not a substitute for ordinary wild fish.
rows.ticket: none: no separate build or switch-off required

rows.what: Gentle wild six and stocked-line ordinary catch items, with fish-population data. Rare seep-stone/silver loot is inventoried separately.
rows.called_by: RM_WeepingStones.fishTypes/maxFishPopulation consumed by ordinary Odyssey fishing
rows.why: Ordinary angling supplies food without a farm; rare seep-stone loot is split into its own deferred row below.
rows.ticket: none: no separate build or switch-off required

rows.what: Native ornamental/grazing/marker flora: dewblade, weep-mat, verdimoss, shadefern and dripfringe; biome density/commonalities and growth data. Descriptions promise wet/shade locations; defs alone do not enforce every stated location.
rows.called_by: Biome wildPlants; Oasis.AdditionalWildPlants; vanilla WildPlantSpawner and regrowth
rows.why: Without flora clustered at wet/shaded habitat the described wet/dry land contrast is lost; no independent plant power is retained.

rows.what: Bladderquill yields bladder-fruit; salvecomb yields herbal medicine; steamfrond yields korrim spice (older documents say seep-salt). Corresponding product/ingredient data present.
rows.called_by: Vanilla harvest jobs read plant.harvestedThingDef for bladder-fruit, medicine and korrim; RM_CookMurrinBroth consumes korrim
rows.why: Forage, medicine and the broth spice are ordinary gathering rewards. Removing them leaves decorative land without the ordinary foraging life promised by the roster.
rows.ticket: none: no separate build or switch-off required

rows.what: Sowable slow crop: 26 growDays, seven fruit per harvest, each 0.5 nutrition and 60-day rot-start data. Owner's crop survives later economy tuning; no question reopens its existence.
rows.called_by: Vanilla sow/grow/harvest + shared ExplosiveGrowth; RM_DewgourdFruit ingestion and rottable lifecycle
rows.why: The owner explicitly required a slow, food-rich, keeping crop in the flora sitting; ordinary farming needs its actual grow/harvest/storage route, not a new irrigation engine.
rows.ticket: none: no separate build or switch-off required

rows.what: Scarce rockfinger timber and later talvessar ember-leaf timber, with owned plant art bindings and growth/yield data; shared dewshrooms supplied by TheRot through composed package.
rows.called_by: Biome wildPlants; vanilla tree growth/cut/wood output; shared shade engine reads geometry
rows.why: Native timber is gatherable from separated trees and local cutting limits further wooden construction. Treeless ground loses ordinary building material, while a continuous timber forest loses this desert building cost. Shared dewshrooms must receive the ruled distinct variant, not a permanent cross-biome identity waiver.

rows.what: Tamed mirrik's vanilla shearable comp yields two cocoons every six days; tailor recipe spins dewsilk fabric with heat-insulation data. Startup setting removes the shearable comp when off.
rows.called_by: Mirrik CompProperties_Shearable; RM_DewsilkSwitch startup; RM_SpinDewsilk recipe
rows.why: Cocoon-to-cloth manufacturing is an independent export loop; deleting it leaves the native flier, farm, food and land intact. Feed has no cocoon-waste dependency in code.

rows.what: Huldu's valuable fur is wired through race.leatherDef to RM_Leather_Huldu, with owned icon binding. Ordinary butcher route differs from pen HARVEST, which gives meat only.
rows.called_by: RM_Huldu.race.leatherDef -> ordinary corpse butchery; pen HARVEST currently emits only meat
rows.why: An ordinary butchery leather product makes an existing tame/hunted animal useful. It adds no harvesting subsystem; no fur is promised from the pen-meat conversion.
rows.ticket: none: no separate build or switch-off required

rows.what: Water-only Pool pen zone on vanilla Zone tab, teal colour, setting visibility, body ID per zone, saved feed clock/state, zone-change/removal hooks, load index rebuilding. Bookkeeping follows zones, not a natural-water flood fill.
rows.called_by: Pool zone designator/zone notifications, all pool work givers and map pulse
rows.why: A designated water zone is the player-selected unit of the farm; without it the player cannot choose where husbandry applies.

rows.what: NET throws an aimed vanilla Projectile at a launch-time cell; movement can outrun it; landing coverage causes 600-tick stun/net mark, approach and bag convert to one breeding-stock item. Throw range and attempts are settings; no 200-tick freeze-to-catch channel.
rows.called_by: RM_WorkGiver_NetPoolBreeder; RM_Projectile_PoolNet
rows.why: Catching moving breeders is the entry into the chosen farming chain; owner net-speed ruling stands.

rows.what: STOCK carries one breeder and releases a new neutral live species pawn after a pen recheck; missing job.count normalised to one, carried item no longer fails despawned check. Nearest reachable pen chosen automatically.
rows.called_by: RM_WorkGiver_StockPoolPen
rows.why: Carrying and releasing breeders is necessary to establish a farm.

rows.what: Daily due-pen scanner carries one nutrition-giving item to a reachable pen cell, resets feed clock and consumes it. Feed amount is one item regardless of pen population; no dedicated scrap filter or bank-only stand cell rule.
rows.called_by: RM_WorkGiver_FeedPoolPen; PoolStock.Notify_Fed
rows.why: Delivered food must sustain actual stock, not merely reset a display clock. Without it husbandry is a passive timer.

rows.what: Live census of fauna standing in the zone, with Healthy/Thin/Silent/Vhorrin state and unfed-days inspect text; broad-ring words are not an actual ring overlay. State updates precede this pulse's mutations.
rows.called_by: RM_MapComponent_PoolStock.Pulse -> RM_PoolBody fields -> RM_Zone_PoolPen.GetInspectString; no overlay caller found
rows.why: Without a visible pen-health warning the player cannot intervene before the signature consumes its stock; inspect text alone does not meet the ruled at-a-glance requirement.

rows.what: Two unfed days classify Thin; three allow per-pulse loss of a non-vhorrin resident. Initial/load grace, saved feed ticks, one-pass population buckets and configurable emergence/escape dice.
rows.called_by: RM_MapComponent_PoolStock.Pulse -> RM_PoolKernel.Decide and pawn.Kill
rows.why: Neglect must cause readable deterioration and recoverable harm, rather than unrelated wild-pool drought.

rows.what: Crowded or long-unfed pen probabilistically replaces one resident with a neutral live vhorrin, suppressing another emergence when census already contains one. Not an ambient roster row; generic population/gauge transition, not demonstrated feeding on other residents.
rows.called_by: PoolStock.Pulse -> TrySpawnVhorrin; RM_WorkGiver_CullVhorrin; no ambient roster source
rows.why: The mismanaged pen becomes a monster: this is the selected experience's consequence, not an ambient wild predator.

rows.what: Per-pulse fan eel escape despawns/respawns a resident at nearby standable non-pen ground; NET can recapture outside pens. Current dice do not require crowding, water on the destination, or a daily wind event; no barrel/cistern event built here.
rows.called_by: PoolStock.Pulse -> TryEscapeVizhik; RM_WorkGiver_NetPoolBreeder scans stockable pawns outside pens
rows.why: A stocked escapee creates the return leg to netting and the owner's over-active stock experience; a visible traversal and recapture are needed, a teleport and debug log are insufficient.

rows.what: Autonomous HARVEST removes a stockable resident in a pen (excluding eel/vhorrin), yields 2–4 species meat and risks minor scratches for skarrin/iaala. NET also risks minor handling injury. One generic harvesting toil; no per-pen reserve or species-specific catch action.
rows.called_by: RM_WorkGiver_HarvestPoolPen; ordinary work scanning
rows.why: Directed harvest converts raised surplus into food at a readable, minor medical cost; unrequested automatic liquidation defeats tending.

rows.what: Single handler remotely stuns vhorrin, approaches, works 420 ticks, removes it, risks a bite and produces 18–24 meat; message announces rescue. This is the shipped simplification, not two-handler coordination or proved fish-stock recovery.
rows.called_by: RM_WorkGiver_CullVhorrin
rows.why: A deliberate cull removes the mismanagement predator so the remaining farm can recover; keeping it alive forever would break the chain. Single-handler action remains the small default.

rows.what: Existing pool-fry, murrin broth, iaala paste and cull-feast recipes, ingredient/catch/meat data and stove wiring; rendered huldu fat is inventoried separately.
rows.called_by: Patches/RM_StockedPoolRecipeWiring.xml -> both stove recipe lists -> ordinary RecipeWorker/ingredient ingestion
rows.why: Ordinary edible outputs and simple stove preparations complete farming as a profession, explicitly requested in the husbandry ruling. Rendered huldu fat is split out and deferred; no new recipe catalogue is commissioned.
rows.ticket: none: no separate build or switch-off required

rows.what: Loomu/huldu/ivvol meats and catch foods have stronger direct and weaker ingredient thoughts; Psychopath/Bloodlust nullify them. Broth and cull feast add positive taste memories. No keeper-specific double penalty, named roast recipe, colony-wide feast event or ideo rule inferred.
rows.called_by: Catch/meat ingestible thought fields and vanilla ingredient-memory handling -> ThoughtDefs; Psychopath/Bloodlust nullifiers
rows.why: Deleting ingestion thoughts turns the owner's real doubt-meat mood economy into description-only flavor. Existing vanilla thoughts complete the choice to raise and eat alien beasts.

rows.what: Opt-in shared EnvironmentalHazards field around water; guilty damaging hit triggers nearby neutral wildlife against aggressor faction, with cooldown and letter. Suppression prevents predator hunts from/to water and abandons a crossing chase; tamed predators included, player hunting unaffected. Shared radius setting.
rows.called_by: Thing.PostApplyDamage postfix; predator prey-selection and hunt-toil patches; biome extension
rows.why: Hunt suppression and guilt-based response protect drinkers at full water. The ruled stocked-pool sheet §1 and §3 Pens and pool zones place designated pen cells outside that truce. The shared dependency needs a narrow pen-cell exclusion hook used by both suppression and retribution, validated through T18.

rows.what: One-per-world spawn latch creates old gorrask on an RM_WeepingStones map's FinalizeInit; saved world flags, season timing and choice letter. Ordinary gorrask remains separate. Initial spawn is local map init, not a world migration event.
rows.called_by: RM_MapComponent_CondenserSpawner.FinalizeInit; RM_CondenserQuestUtil.FindCrab
rows.why: A unique quest-bearing animal is a second system, not ordinary gorrask wildlife or a necessary part of a fish farm. Ordinary RM_Gorrask remains.

rows.what: Seasonal Settled/Waiting/Walking machine grows shallow-water cells, rebuilds truce, letters drying and restores recorded terrain over days on ordinary moves. Protects floors, foundations, edifices and temporary terrain; restores under bridge layers; death/despawn dries immediately and avoids cross-map coordinate restoration.
rows.called_by: RM_CompWalkingCondenser.CompTickRare; quest transfer/extraction/despawn cleanup
rows.why: Seasonal mobile terrain creation/removal is a second signature. Fixed landmark pools already supply land and the farm.

rows.what: Season-choice Guide sets a reachable site near a random home-area cell (else first colonist), rejection message if no site, then phase machine orders movement. Choice letter removes itself only when action succeeds.

rows.why: Guiding a migrating oasis only serves the deferred walking condenser.

rows.called_by: RM_ChoiceLetter_Condenser.Choices -> Choice_Sell
rows.why: Selling a seasonal destination is a separate faction trade action. The farm and normal caravan trade do not call it.

rows.what: Season-choice extraction dries pool, ends moving-oasis world flag, creates/minifies ancient plant, kills crab and letters the loss. No physical surgery job; placement result unchecked; no guilty damage attributed to colony in this action.

rows.why: Killing a unique crab to extract portable machinery is a separate salvage choice. It is not required for fish-farming tools.

rows.what: Portable unpowered rare-ticking building accumulates time, produces RM_CondenserWater flasks with nearby cap and bounds-checked scans; saved accumulator. Flasks are resources; no thirst or ship life-support consumer inferred.
rows.called_by: AncientCondenser ThingDef comp; Choice_Cut supplies building
rows.why: Portable flask production is its own water-resource loop with no farm feed consumer; do not conflate it with OasisMaker.

rows.what: Optional random offer gated on living undowned unclaimed crab on player-home map; deadline to subdue, downed watcher, offstage live transfer to world pawn, ends oasis, rewards/goodwill and sad letter; death/hostility/map loss/timeouts fail.
rows.called_by: QuestScriptDef RM_CondenserCapture and custom quest nodes
rows.why: An optional collector quest is expressly an extra, even though previously approved and built.

rows.why: A trophy-hunter defense contract adds raids, faction rewards and freedom adjudication outside the farm chain.
